rationale: The plan correctly identifies the 3' tag-seq implication—no length correction, no TPM/FPKM, median-of-ratios inside DESeq2—and fits a ~condition Wald model with BH and apeglm shrinkage, with PCA and distance heatmap on VST counts and an honest n=3 caveat. It has no explicit low-count prefilter (only default independent filtering, with no floor or genes-kept count), the reference level and results() contrast are not stated, and the |log2FC|>1 cutoff is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold. Enrichment is not warranted by the question yet is added with no explicit ORA universe, no collection versions, and no set-size window, plus an unrequested PPI step; the report spec omits package versions and counts of tested versus significant genes.
